name: Sean Gorman
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Sean Gorman attended law school and graduated from University of Houston Law Center in 1988. Sean Gorman began practicing law in 1988.
Sean Gorman is an attorney at White & Case LLP, helping people with Business Litigation issues. White & Case LLP has an office in Houston, Texas, serving the local community.

Sean Gorman was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
